definitions.explanation: A person who trains athletes or teaches specific skills.

examples.japanese: コーチに{厳|きび}しく{指導|しどう}された。
examples.english: I was strictly trained by my coach.

examples.japanese: {野球|やきゅう}チームの{新|あたら}しいコーチが{決|き}まった。
examples.english: The baseball team's new coach has been decided.

examples.japanese: コーチの{言|い}うことを{聞|き}いて、{練習|れんしゅう}を{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: I listened to my coach and kept practicing.

notes:
USAGE: コーチ is used for sports coaches and trainers. It differs from 監督 (manager/director) who has overall team responsibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・コーチを{務|つと}める (to serve as a coach)
・コーチに{なる|} (to become a coach)
・{個人|こじん}コーチ (personal coach)
・ヘッドコーチ (head coach)
・アシスタントコーチ (assistant coach)

RELATED WORDS:
・{監督|かんとく} (manager, director - higher position)
・トレーナー (trainer - often for physical conditioning)
・{指導者|しどうしゃ} (instructor, leader)
